name: Primal Kitchen Avocado Oil Mayo (Clean Egg & Avocado Emulsion)
whyItWorks: Uses 100% pure avocado oil (rich in anti-inflammatory monounsaturated oleic acid) rather than refined soybean or canola oil. Contains organic cage-free eggs, vinegar, and salt without added sugars or artificial gums.
prepOrOrderInstructions: An ideal anti-inflammatory mayonnaise for salads, canned salmon, and wraps.
watchOuts: Rich in healthy fats; consume in standard 1-tablespoon servings.
